sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows 2376 ppm defects (sc:70140@2026Q3).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 45.15 per unit (po:4500014429-10, po:4500014373-10, po:4500014306-10).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hello,
many thanks, good to have your reply!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.
To be fully transparent with you:
We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.
We really need you to pay on time though, as late payments are hurting us.
Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 2500 ppm: €45.50 per unit.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
We are ready when you are!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Hello,

Thanks for the new offer! We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. We can drop the price to €45.50, but we really need faster payment to make this work for us.

So, we can offer a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
